findings.title: future-Delivery genericity proof 只有静态模型，没有真实 next-consumer
findings.problem: 045 在 Risk Scan 中把 Generic reusable subsystem 与跨 Change/Delivery activation persistence 都标为 yes，且 D1 v6 acceptance 明确要求 future Delivery can form Planned without Bootstrap exception；但 Proof G 的 Method 只区分 03-specific SHA 与 dynamic <delivery-id> path、读取现有 persisted facts，没有创建/执行任何 different future-Delivery-shaped fixture、prototype 或 consumer。Evidence Boundary 却直接声明覆盖 future Delivery，Result=PASS。这把“设计上看起来可泛化”当成了“跨 Delivery 已证明可泛化”。
findings.contractRef: 03 Delivery Execution Loop Planned Changes v6 D1 Required proofs / acceptance: future Delivery can form Planned without Bootstrap exception；Flowkit Explore Skill v2 §4.5 Genericity / Next-consumer Proof 与 §5 Proof Acceptance Depth
findings.invariant: 当 Change 声明 generic reusable subsystem 且 required outcome 跨 Delivery 长期生效时，Explore 必须至少增加一个 future-Delivery-shaped consumer；same-Delivery facts、dynamic path 文案或静态常量分离不能单独证明 future-Delivery PASS。Evidence Boundary 必须实际覆盖 Acceptance Boundary。
findings.requiredOutcome: Revise Explore with one minimal future-Delivery-shaped next-consumer proof. Use a delivery identity distinct from 20260817-01, prove the proposed generic path/provenance/render boundary derives that Delivery's own Current/Planned locations and planning provenance from formal future-Delivery facts (not 74d46f0/f132db7 constants), and exercise the relevant prototype/fixture far enough to show the same managed Archify repository-evidence route can consume it. Keep Accepted Actual -> SystemArchitectureRef promotion in E1 and do not introduce Registry/DB/automatic architecture inference.
acceptance: A disposable/synthetic future Delivery with a different deliveryId is exercised, not merely described.

The demonstrated architecture paths are derived as architecture/<future-delivery-id>/json/current.architecture.json and planned.architecture.json with no hardcoded 03 deliveryId or 74d46f0/f132db7 in generic resolver/service behavior.
Future Current/Planned provenance is sourced from future-shaped formal facts (prior accepted architecture/Git baseline and that Delivery's own Start facts) rather than the 03 Bootstrap exception.

The proof reaches an actual next-consumer/prototype boundary sufficient to show managed Archify repository-evidence validate/render remains feasible for the future-shaped asset, or records any remaining gap as UNKNOWN instead of PASS.
E1-only Actual acceptance/promotion, Architecture Registry/DB, per-Change regeneration and new Formal Actions remain out of scope.

findings.title: Proposal 应冻结 HTML 默认不进入 Git boundary 的工程机制
findings.problem: 045 正确冻结 `architecture/<delivery-id>/html/**` 为 local generated / default not committed，但当前 Base `.gitignore` 没有 architecture HTML 规则，045 的 required mutation surface 也没有说明采用 `.gitignore`、checkpoint staging exclusion 或其他等价机制。Explore 阶段这不阻塞 feasibility，但 Proposal 应明确一种最小机制，避免 derived HTML 在正常 render 后成为容易误带入 checkpoint 的普通 untracked output。
findings.contractRef: 03 Delivery Execution Loop v6 Repository Architecture Assets / D1 HTML lifecycle: html/** local disposable generated view, default not committed, non-authoritative
findings.invariant: Derived HTML 不得成为 durable architecture authority，正常 render 后应有明确、可审查的默认 Git-boundary hygiene；实现方式可以是 .gitignore 或其他等价的最薄机制，不应建立 freshness ledger。
